senses.definition: bring about wind and rain through supernatural or magical power

examples.sentence: 张角日夜学习，学会呼风唤雨，自称太平道人。

previous.explanation_en: 呼风唤雨 means to bring about wind and rain through supernatural or magical power: 呼风 and 唤雨 pair two ways of summoning with the weather they summon.

parts.contribution_en: 呼 means call or summon, and 风 is wind.
唤 means summon, and 雨 is rain.

requests.reason: Focused decomposition correction after independent audit: 呼风 and 唤雨 are paired halves of the expression rather than independently reusable lexical units. Split them into characters to show the actions and their objects. Use structured parts 呼|风|唤|雨, with precise contributions. Preserve the whole-word meaning and all senses. Do not invent standalone dictionary words from convenient halves of an expression. Do not introduce historical claims or rewrite unrelated explanations.
